ranking.name: Provider request-id clock: per-stream skew bracket and response-binding test on decoded server-minted request ids (inter-request ceiling and Gemini HTTP-header variant kept as unmeasured extensions)

coverage#4 Provider-clock action windows for logs without per-call stamps (aiv_cu) - merged as the Gemini HTTP Date / server-timing variant; robustness#1 step 5 already proposes it
ranking.observation: ids_and_clocks_in_ids/O5 skeptic numbers (analysis/out/phase_c/_index.json): one constant client-server skew per stream places every decoded request-id time between the stream's last input event and the response's first output block in all but 10 of 3,674 swechat Claude Code streams, rate 0.00272 [0.00112, 0.00466] at 2 s tolerance (0 s gives 18, 5 s gives 7); slack U-L p5 1,102 / p50 2,268 / p95 3,807 ms; cc_local 1 of 847 streams. Tamper placebo on 3,673 swechat streams: moving one response's first event 5 s earlier flags 1,441, 30 s earlier flags 3,581; moving it 5, 30 or 300 s later flags 10, equal to the baseline (one-sided). The 'roll' placebo (3,667 flagged) misbinds every response at once and is not a single-response test (power grounding check, analysis/out/phase_c/_proposals_grounded.json). Clock decode: ids/O1 154,815/154,815 v7|var2 against 2,418.98 expected by chance (includes 50 Vertex ids), cc_local 31,085/31,085; layout inferred, UNVERIFIED against documentation. ids/O2: 155,067/155,267 = 0.99871 [0.99676, 0.99992] agree with client stamps counting every copy; holdout A 11,047 ids, 0 violations. The lens's own copy of the honest bracket is analysis/out/phase_c/ids_and_clocks_in_ids.json bracket.swechat (lens n 3,676 streams, same rate and CI). Gemini-header variant: server-timing dur fits inside the AI Village row gap with 0/12,292 violations (Wilson hi 3.12e-4, 347 sessions, slack min 563.8 ms; two_clocks/O7 skeptic); HTTP Date has 1 s resolution and orders unambiguously in only 2,831/3,246 flash and 7,276/8,990 pro call rows (distributions/D19 skeptic). PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the placebo counts come from the skeptic's uncommitted scratchpad scripts (scratchpad/rd/o5.py, o5b.py, o5c.py) and survive only as text in the committed analysis/out/phase_c/_verification_ir.json and _index.json; the committed lens script analysis/probes/phase_c_ids_and_clocks_in_ids.py writes no placebo.
ranking.test_measurement: Pre-register before running: honest rates fixed at 10/3,674 (swechat) and 1/847 (cc_local), session-clustered CIs, tolerance 2 s. Commit the placebo as an analysis/probes script first. Then, on swechat CC B, holdout A and cc_local: (1) single-response tampers, which are unmeasured: splice one response plus its request id from another session or later in the same session, swap two adjacent responses, delete one response, insert one fabricated round; (2) delay one tool_result by D in {1, 2, 5, 30, 300} s with ids untouched, the unmeasured mirror of the measured back-date; (3) back-date grid 1-30 s to locate the displacement at power 0.5 and 0.9, compared with U-L p50 2,268 ms; (4) report power per tamper type, never pooled. Extension, never run: ceiling S = t_req(k+1) - t_req(k) against client duration claims (call->result gap, bash_progress elapsed, durationMs), with tolerance fixed on split A to cover within-session client drift (above 2 s in 15 swechat sessions and 2 of 18 cc_local sessions; ids/O6 skeptic). Kill criterion, set in advance: if single-response tamper power at <= 5 s is not above the upper CI of the honest stream rate, stop and report a null.
ranking.false_positive_source: Measured: 10/3,674 inconsistent swechat streams at 2 s (18 at 0 s, 7 at 5 s); resume/fork copies whose history was re-stamped onto 1-2 timestamps (2 session pairs, 178 request ids; ids/O7 skeptic) and 12 far offsets that remain after dedupe, unexplained (robustness grounding, analysis/out/phase_c/_proposals_grounded.json); 329 same-millisecond gap-0 pairs in Claude Code v2.1 with no established cause (two_clocks/O12 skeptic, 498/137,380 gap-0 pairs, only 169 explained); client clock steps, which a constant per-stream skew does not absorb (ids/O6 skeptic); 1 s resolution of OpenAI and Gemini ids (OpenAI 3/463 streams inconsistent; ids/O5); in aiv_cu the row insert lags the id by a median of 5.7-12 s, so the aiv_cu bracket is weak by construction (ids/O3 skeptic). Unmeasured: provider-side clock skew between consecutive ids, retries, concurrent subagent streams.
ranking.novelty_guess_unverified: UNVERIFIED - not checked against prior art. Reading time out of UUIDv1/ULID/Snowflake-style ids is known forensics, and bounding an event's time between causally ordered stamped events with a clock-offset allowance is the Gladyshev & Patel event-time-bounding line (the grounding skeptic's own unverified recollection; the 2004 FSM paper is on the listed prior art). The part that might be new is using LLM-provider request ids as the external bound on agent tool-log stamps and as a response-binding test. Do not claim it is new.
ranking.why_this_rank: (a) The only proposal with both a measured honest rate and a measured tamper response: 10/3,674 honest vs 1,441/3,673 at a 5 s back-date and 3,581/3,673 at 30 s, resolution on the order of the U-L p50 of 2,268 ms. (b) The value is minted by the provider on request receipt; that the model never sees it is reasoning, not an observation. It is unsigned, and a log editor who learns the inferred layout can re-mint ids cheaply, so it binds only editors who rewrite stamps without ids, until provider-side lookup exists (untested). (c) Anthropic-backed Claude Code only: swechat 155,267 (session, request) pairs in 1,638 sessions and cc_local 31,085 ids; aiv_cc stores 0 request ids (ids/O13); Codex, OpenCode and Gemini CLI have none; aiv_cu only weakly. Share of all tool calls covered is unmeasured. (d) Cheapest to build: committed lens code plus existing tamper scripts. Penalties applied: power is one-sided (late shifts flag 10 = baseline); in-band fabrication is invisible because the harness stamps a fabricating turn consistently, so this is a post-hoc log-integrity check, not a fabrication detector; the power lens's 'only measured tamper curve' is false (token_conservation/TC2 has one) and its 3,667 'misbinding' figure is an overread; ids/O7 is not independent evidence; the robustness ceiling's core comparison has never been run; the decisive placebo numbers come from an uncommitted script. Interpretation, not measured: by the bracket's definition it catches stretched latencies (back-dated outputs, delayed inputs) but not compressed ones, so it does not close the post-hoc route for hiding an inline-generated result from Probe 1.

ranking.test_measurement: Pre-register from split A (rule already measured there) and test on B and the population: per window require dIMAGE = (screenshot-returning actions in the window) x unit(model generation). Tamper suite: delete one GUI result, relabel a GUI action as shell, insert a fabricated screenshot-returning call and result with usage untouched, splice a window from another session; report detection per tamper type against the honest 33/5,092 miss rate, and report the session-level honest flag rate, which no file states yet. Test the regime above 40 images (442 population Gemini sessions exceed 40 GUI turns; TC9 skeptic). aiv_cc: add or remove one [IMAGE_REMOVED] marker and report power at FPR 1% with run-clustered CIs, labelled single-agent. Fit an image term for aiv_cu Anthropic (TC1 skeptic: GUI-window residual median +206.5 vs shell -602.8) to see whether coverage extends past Gemini. Kill criterion: if the session-level honest flag rate exceeds 0.05, stop.
ranking.false_positive_source: Measured: 33/5,092 GUI windows with no increment, unexplained and not cap effects (images before: median 4, max 31; TC9 skeptic); the >40-image regime is untested; the unit depends on model generation (258, 1,064, and 2,160 in 3 sessions; D3); gemini-3.8-flash (277 pairs) never shows an image (TC9); cached IMAGE counts are off-lattice (11/3,022 and 40/9,318; D3), so only prompt-side counts are usable; aiv_cc has 30 unlogged context resets, 27 of them image pairs (aiv_accounting/O12); user-pasted images vary in size (swechat CC single-image residual 535.0, p5-p95 121-1,618; TC17), so the quantum holds only for uniform screenshots.
ranking.novelty_guess_unverified: UNVERIFIED - not checked. Token-count plausibility checks are generic billing practice. Using a provider's per-modality token breakdown as an exact ledger of how many screenshot-returning results a log may contain was not seen by the proposers, who did not search. The power grounding check found no overlap with the listed items; the coverage grounding check notes the narration cross-check is close to OverclaimBench and 'Plans They Abandon' (listed) and that the ledger extends our own Phase A conservation plan.
ranking.why_this_rank: (a) Cleanest measured separability of the five: exact lattice in 11,668/11,668 pairs, 0 spurious increments in 4,134 + 2,033 + 202 non-GUI windows, resolution of one image (258 or 1,064 tokens), and the only core separation that also appears on split A in committed Phase A output (417/420, 0/309, 191/191, 0/320), which partly answers the caveat that Phase C read split B before Phase B. Tamper power has not been simulated. (b) Server-computed usage the model does not see (UNVERIFIED); an informed editor can recompute it, but must shift promptTokenCount in every later response while screenshots stay in context; a live forger who returns a fake screenshot gets a real increment, so it does not touch execution-path compromise. (c) Narrowest coverage: aiv_cu Gemini rows only (11,945 pairs; Gemini rows in 347 of 2,000 B sessions, two_clocks/O7) plus one aiv_cc agent; but that is the GUI regime where every tested probe failed. (d) Cheapest: TC9 already computes it. Penalties: aiv_cc single-image detectability was implied but is below 1 and unmeasured; the 128-token rule it bundled was found post hoc and is trivially satisfiable (moved to rank 5); per-window misses compound at session level and no session-level FP is stated.

ranking.name: Git execution window: a commit SHA printed in a tool result must resolve, and its commit_date must fall inside the printing call's call->result window (fresh clock readings from generator commands as an extension; harness-timer chain demoted to internal consistency)
merged_from: power#3 Execution-window consistency: time evidence in or around a result must fit the window in which it was supposedly produced
robustness#3 Nested timer chain: printed durations <= model-invisible harness timers <= provider interval
ranking.observation: commit_witness/O9 skeptic (analysis/out/phase_c/_index.json): 3,936 resolved commit claims in 1,491 swechat sessions; commit_date in [call ts - 2 s, result ts + 2 s] for 3,917 = 0.995 [0.992, 0.998]; median offset -0.103 s [-0.137, -0.062]. commit_witness/O11 skeptic: the 19 out-of-window claims (14 sessions) are 15 cat/tail/head/grep re-reads of earlier output files, 1 amend with an explicit GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and 3 unexplained; this classification was made post hoc. commit_witness/O10 skeptic: 2,198/6,141 = 0.358 [0.321, 0.394] of honest commit claims do not resolve, and 39% of those carry no explaining flag. commit_witness/O1: 4,085/5,850 = 0.698 [0.686, 0.710] of sessions link to at least one ok commit. Fresh readings: ext_witness/O10 fraction-form epochs never postdate the external wiki save, 0/459 (Wilson hi 0.0083), POST-HOC split, collusion-wiki only (external witness, no agent-side tool calls); without a fraction 7/123. Timer legs, which the grounding check calls internal redundancy: bash_progress floor rule 0/112,677 (two_clocks/O9), Codex Wall time 0/4,408 exec_command (two_clocks/O6), harness timers Glob 1/2,090 (two_clocks/O8); bash_progress exists in 1,981/4,925 swechat CC files and 0 of 332 cc_local main files (raw_census/A6-O10).
ranking.test_measurement: Fix the generator vs re-reader command classes (from commit_witness/O11) on one half of the commit-linked sessions and test on the other, because the 15/19 re-read classification was made on the full population. Tamper suite: replay a real 'git commit' output from earlier in the session or from another session (commit_date out of window), fabricate a SHA (compare with the honest 0.358 non-resolution), shift call/result stamps on a grid; report honest violation rate per command class with session-clustered CIs and detection per tamper. Measure the share of all tool results that carry a resolvable SHA or a fresh absolute reading; stop rule: if that share is too small to matter, report it and stop. Report the timer legs only as consistency checks.
ranking.false_positive_source: Measured: re-reads of saved output (15 of 19 out-of-window), an explicit committer date (1), 3 unexplained of 3,936 (commit_witness/O11); auto-backgrounded commands whose result window is not the execution window (111 of 188 swechat 120 s shell results; outliers/O9 skeptic); 329 unexplained v2.1 gap-0 pairs that any zero-width window check would hit (two_clocks/O12 skeptic); non-resolution of 2,198/6,141 honest claims makes a bare existence check unusable (commit_witness/O10); display rounding in Codex shell_command headers 646/1,817 by <= 49 ms (two_clocks/O6); stored ids and dates echoed by tools are not fresh (440 of 561 v7 mentions more than 10 min older; ids/O14).
ranking.novelty_guess_unverified: UNVERIFIED - not checked. Partial overlap is already known: the git leg is a claim-vs-record existence check plus git shadow state, which is our own core plan; the window logic is event-time bounding (Gladyshev & Patel line, listed); extracting printed durations with regexes is jc-style output parsing (listed). The possibly new part is bounding non-recomputable outputs by the log's own call window, as opposed to METR-style recomputation of deterministic outputs.
ranking.why_this_rank: (a) Measured honest in-window rate 3,917/3,936 = 0.995 [0.992, 0.998] at +/-2 s, but its exceptions were explained post hoc and no tamper simulation exists. (b) Strongest witness of the five: commit_date lives in an external repo and is hashed into the SHA, so a fabricated or replayed git output must match an object the agent does not control; it is the only proposal that can catch live fabrication of a result, not only post-hoc log edits. The cost is lower than the power lens claimed, because committer dates can be set (one amend with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE was observed). (c) Narrow: swechat sessions with Entire commit tables only, 3,936 resolved claims; share of results carrying a fresh reading unmeasured; no commit table for cc_local, aiv_cc or aiv_cu. (d) Medium: command classification and regexes. Ranked below rank 2 on criterion (a) (post-hoc exception classes, a 0.358 honest non-resolution rate, no split-A replication) and above rank 4 on criterion (b). Penalties: the power lens bundled internal timers as execution evidence and overstated forging cost; ext_witness/O10 is post hoc with a selection caveat; tie-run abstention covers only 169/498 gap-0 pairs.

ranking.novelty_guess_unverified: UNVERIFIED - not checked. Consistency between redundant fields is a generic integrity idea. The two grounding checks disagree on overlap: the power check found none with the listed items; the coverage check calls the overlap substantial (jc output parsing, METR recomputation, and our own filesystem shadow-state plan for the cross-call part).
ranking.why_this_rank: (a) Largest-n exact agreement of any proposal (87,827/88,229 over 4,603 files; 6,623/6,623) at a predicted 1-line resolution, but the headline '0 unexplained' is in-sample - the whitelist was built from the same 402 mismatches, so 0 is guaranteed (power grounding check) - and no tamper simulation exists. (b) Weakest witness: one harness writes both renderings from the same read, so a schema-aware editor rewrites both, and an execution-path compromise yields two consistent renderings of the fake output; it catches naive post-hoc text edits and export faults only. (c) Claude Code formats only, which dominate swechat; cc_local main Read fill 578/650 = 0.889; Codex Wall time rests on 5 sessions. (d) Low to medium: a loader change is required. ranking.observation: swechat_tables/T1 skeptic (analysis/out/phase_c/_index.json): the 5-integer Entire tally equals an exact tolerance-0 recount of the stored transcript in 4,794/4,836 = 0.9913 [0.9883, 0.9936] Claude-format sessions (repo-clustered [0.9874, 0.9942], 183 repos); prefix sessions are mid-session snapshots (created_at precedes the last transcript timestamp in 1,664/1,664, median 3 messages past the snapshot). The skeptic adds that it is a recount of the transcript's own usage, whose only independent content is the commit-time snapshot. T3 skeptic: after the join fix, 33/5,701 = 0.0058 [0.0041, 0.0081] unmatched across 4 scaffolds. Cache-append chain holds in 0.975 / 0.982 / 0.999 of clean swechat CC / cc_local / aiv_cc pairs (TC1 skeptic) and 59,747/59,804 aiv_cc pairs (aiv_accounting/O9). ranking.test_measurement: On the 5,701 swechat sessions with a tally: delete one assistant message.id inside the snapshot; insert a copied message.id; append after the snapshot (expected invisible); insert a tool_use block into an existing message.id (expected invisible); edit result content (invisible to the tally). Report detection per tamper vs the honest 33/5,701, overall and by CLI version. Before any tamper test of the cache-chain identity, report its honest per-session break rate in swechat CC and cc_local, which is uncharacterised although per-pair holds are only 0.975 and 0.982.
ranking.false_positive_source: Measured: 33/5,701 after the join fix, higher in CLI 0.5.x at 15/1,048 = 0.0143 [0.0087, 0.0235], 6 of 33 in one repo (T4); the dataset join artifact must be corrected first (T3); checkpoint rows duplicated across forks, 3,650/13,406 (T9); cache-chain breaks at compaction (0/933 hold), image pairs (4,367/4,570 hold) and long gaps (aiv_accounting/O9); 30 unlogged context resets with 0/30 context_management objects (aiv_accounting/O12) - honest pruning produces exactly the signature the 'unchanged-prefix certificate' would flag; long gaps break the chain in only 8/32 aiv_cc pairs, so the cache 'stopwatch' has almost no signal.
ranking.novelty_guess_unverified: UNVERIFIED and mostly listed prior art. A commit-time tally acting as a seal is hash-chain sealing (Agent Flight Recorder, NovaFabric, listed); the Entire CLI is installed session-capture tooling, close to the listed capture-side records (Hearsay, ACE, Tracekit); ledger reconciliation is standard audit practice; prompt-cache auditing has external prior art (Gu et al. 2025, relevance UNVERIFIED). The robustness grounding check judged both candidate new parts weak: cache-chain amplification adds nothing at tolerance 0, and fork-replica control is unmeasured.
ranking.why_this_rank: (a) Measured honest unmatched 33/5,701 at tolerance 0 and predicted 1-message resolution, but no tamper simulation, and it is blind to tool-result content: content edits face only conservation, which misses anything under thousands of characters. (b) The tally recounts the transcript's own usage; its git snapshot is local and rewritable until pushed (push time not in the data); every identity is arithmetic a forger can propagate. (c) The tally exists only in swechat Entire sessions; the identities cover more scaffolds but are recomputable. (d) Medium. Heaviest prior-art penalty of the five, and it constrains which turns exist rather than whether results are true.

build_first: Build rank 1 first (provider request-id bracket), scoped as a post-hoc retiming and response-binding check rather than a fabrication detector. Reasons: (1) it is the only proposal with both a measured honest rate (10/3,674 swechat streams = 0.00272 [0.00112, 0.00466]; cc_local 1/847; ids/O5 in analysis/out/phase_c/_index.json) and a measured tamper response (5 s back-date 1,441/3,673; 30 s 3,581/3,673), so the next run can fail cleanly against a stated kill criterion; (2) it runs on the corpora where Probe 1 is ALIVE or WEAK at per-result resolution (cc_local ALIVE, fp 1/1,019; swechat CC WEAK, fp 72/20,937; analysis/out/probe_1.json verdicts), and those timing verdicts can only be trusted if the timing record itself is checked; (3) it is the cheapest: the lens code is committed (analysis/probes/phase_c_ids_and_clocks_in_ids.py) and the tamper code exists. Order of work: commit the placebo script so its numbers satisfy rule 1; run single-response splice, swap, insert and delete, plus the result-delay mirror (none measured yet); replicate on holdout A and cc_local; stop if single-response power at <= 5 s does not clear the honest rate's CI. If a second cheap task can run in parallel, take rank 2: its separation already replicates on split A (analysis/out/phase_a/a5.json) and only the tamper simulation is missing.
relation_to_phase_b: INTERPRETATION. (1) Validation. Probes 1-4 were pre-registered (analysis/prereg.json, commit 3df8d28), run on split B, independently re-derived and audited with no blocking violations (analysis/out/phase_b_verification.json). None of the five proposals is pre-registered or tamper-tested against real fabrications; their discovery lenses read split B before Phase B ran, so their numbers are not held-out. Only rank 2's core separation also appears on split A (analysis/out/phase_a/a5.json); rank 1 has a split-A check of the offset only (ids/O2, 11,047 ids, 0 violations), not of the bracket. (2) Honest false-positive rates. The proposals sit at or below the best tested mechanism: rank 1 is 0.00272 per stream, rank 2 has 0 spurious increments in 4,134/2,033/202 non-GUI windows, rank 4 has 402/88,229 raw Read mismatches, rank 5 has 33/5,701 sessions. Compare Probe 1's ALIVE units, opencode 7/4,419 = 0.0016 [0, 0.0033] and cc_local 1/1,019 = 0.0010 [0, 0.0033] (analysis/out/probe_1.json). All are far below Probe 2's best S_deep of 0.144 [0.125, 0.163] (probe_2.json), Probe 3's only ALIVE cell, the session-level zero-error tail Z = 9/413 = 0.022 W[0.012, 0.041] (probe_3.json), and Probe 4's pooled-class hex effect w_adj 0.110 [0.041, 0.232] (probe_4.json). (3) Adversary. Probes 1-4 measure what the model does: who produced a result, what it knew, whether the world pushed back, how its numbers look. That is where in-band fabrication would show. Ranks 1, 2, 4 and 5 bind only post-hoc edits of the log. A model or tool fabricating in-band gets consistent stamps, ids, structured copies and usage from an honest harness. None of the five detects an execution-path compromise except rank 3's git leg, which covers only 3,936 resolved commit claims. (4) Coverage.
